meta.name: capital-allocation
meta.description: Evaluates where to spend limited capital — investment appraisal, hurdle rates, payback, and comparing proposals that are not alike. Use this to evaluate an investment or major purchase, compare competing funding requests, set a hurdle rate, decide between building and buying, or review whether past investments delivered what was claimed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估投资与采购,合理分配每一笔资金
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要决定把钱投向哪个项目或评估一笔大额采购是否值得。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate investments and allocate limited capital wisely.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must rank investment opportunities and set hurdle rates.

howto.what: 装上技能后,处理投资或花钱问题时,Claude 只计算这项决定真正改变的现金流,不算沉没成本,也不理与决定无关的固定分摊;用净现值做决定,回本期只看资金风险与不确定性,并追问关键假设、不做的后果和负责人,事后核对当初承诺。
howto.when: 当你提出要评估一项投资或大宗采购、比较几个争夺资金的项目、或设定一个门槛回报率等资本分配问题时触发。

say.text: 评估一下我买这套设备值不值
say.note: Claude 会按增量现金流和净现值来帮你看

say.text: 这两个项目都想用这笔预算,该投哪个
say.note: Claude 会对比现金流、风险与可分批投入的节点

say.text: 给这个项目定一个最低回报率吧
say.note: Claude 会按项目自身风险给门槛,而不是全公司一刀切

howto.what_en: Claude appraises spending only on decision-changing cash flows, ignores sunk costs and fixed overhead, decides with NPV, uses payback for uncertainty, and asks about assumptions, counterfactuals, ownership and ex-post review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to evaluate an investment or major purchase, compare competing funding requests, set a hurdle rate, or handle similar capital-allocation decisions.

say_en.text: Evaluate whether I should buy this equipment
say_en.note: Claude will compute incremental cash flow, NPV and payback

say_en.text: Two projects want the same budget. Which should we fund?
say_en.note: Claude compares cash flow, risk, and staging options

say_en.text: What hurdle rate should we set for this project?
say_en.note: Claude tailors the rate to this project's risk
